UI_qdx_item_condition_option_hotbar_prog: Choose how the condition indicator is displayed in the hotbar.
Controls the transparency of the hotbar condition indicator.
UI_qdx_item_condition_option_equipped_pr: Choose how the condition indicator is displayed on equipped items.
Controls the transparency of the equipped item condition indicator.
